page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying processor is an AMD EPYC 9T25 running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. This instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the ecs.c9a.large provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this configuration.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c9a.large is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, batch processing, microservices, and entry-level application hosting where dedicated CPU resources are preferred over shared-core alternatives.
